bookInfo.name: Old History of the Five Dynasties
bookInfo.author: Xue Juzheng et al.

title.zh: 卷四十二 唐書18: 明宗本紀八
title.en: Volume 42 Book of Later Tang 18: Mingzong Annals 8
title.raw: 卷四十二 唐書18: 明宗本紀八 Volume 42 Book of Later Tang 18: Mingzong Annals 8

sentences.zh: 長興二年春正月庚申朔，帝御明堂殿受朝賀，仗衛如儀。

translations.literal: In the second year of Changxing, spring, first month, gengshen new moon: the Emperor took the Bright Hall to receive court congratulations; guards and retinue were as prescribed.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen new moon of the first month in spring of Changxing 2 Mingzong received New Year congratulations at the Bright Hall with full ceremonial guard.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔曰：「故天策上將軍、守太師、尚書令、楚國王馬殷，品位俱高，封崇已極，無官可贈，宜賜諡及神道碑文，仍以王禮葬。

translations.literal: On yichou an edict said: "The late Celestial Strategy supreme general, Grand Preceptor, Master of Writing, King of Chu Ma Yin—rank and titles were all high, enfeoffment and honor already at the limit; no office can be conferred in addition—he should be granted a posthumous title and spirit-pathway stele text and be buried with royal rites.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou an edict said the late King of Chu Ma Yin, whose ranks were already supreme, could not be given further posts but should receive a posthumous title, spirit-way stele, and royal burial.

sentences.zh: 」壬申，契丹東丹王突欲自渤海國率眾到闕，帝慰勞久之，錫賚加等，百僚稱賀。

translations.literal: 」On renshen the Khitan Eastern Dan king Tuyu from Bohai led his following to the capital; the Emperor comforted him at length, rewards were raised a grade, and the hundred officials congratulated.
translations.idiomatic: 」On renshen the Khitan Eastern Dan prince Tuyu arrived from Bohai with his followers; Mingzong received him at length with enhanced gifts while the court congratulated.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以沙州節度使曹義金兼中書令。

translations.literal: On bingzi Shazhou military commissioner Cao Yijin was made concurrent Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Cao Yijin of Shazhou became concurrent secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，東丹王托雲進本國印三紐。

translations.literal: On dingchou the Eastern Dan king Tuoyun presented three seals of his state.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Eastern Dan king Tuoyun presented three state seals.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以靜江軍節度使馬賓卒廢朝，贈尚書令。

translations.literal: On gengchen Jingjiang Army military commissioner Ma Bin died—court suspended; he was posthumously made Master of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Ma Bin of Jingjiang died; court was suspended and he was posthumously made master of writing.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，荊南節度使高從誨落起復，加兼中書令。

translations.literal: On bingxu Jingnan military commissioner Gao Conghui was released from mourning recall and made concurrent Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Gao Conghui of Jingnan left mourning recall and became concurrent secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑朔，以宋州節度使趙延壽為左武衛上將軍，充宣徽北院使。

translations.literal: Second month, jichou new moon: Song prefecture military commissioner Zhao Yanshou was made Left Martial Guard senior general and Northern Palace Bureau commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou new moon of the second month Zhao Yanshou of Song became left martial guard senior general and northern palace bureau commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔貢院舊例夜試進士，今後晝試，排門齊入，即日試畢。

translations.literal: On guisi an edict: the Examination Court's old custom was night examination of presented scholars; hereafter day examination—line up at the gate and enter together, finishing the test the same day.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi an edict moved the civil service examination from night to day, entrants entering together and finishing the same day.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，幸至德宮，又幸安元信、東丹王突欲之第。

translations.literal: On dingyou the Emperor visited the Palace of Utmost Virtue, and also visited the residences of An Yuanxin and Eastern Dan king Tuyu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Mingzong visited the Palace of Utmost Virtue and the homes of An Yuanxin and Eastern Dan prince Tuyu.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以鴻臚卿致仕賈馥卒廢朝。

translations.literal: On xinchou the retired Master of Guests Jia Fu died—court suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou retired master of guests Jia Fu died and court was suspended.

sentences.zh: 以樞密院使、守太尉、兼中書令安重誨為檢校太師、兼中書令，充河中節度使，進封沂國公。

translations.literal: Privy Commissioner, Grand Commandant, and concurrent Secretariat Director An Chonghui was made Inspector Grand Master, concurrent Secretariat Director, Hedong circuit military commissioner, advanced to Duke of Yi.
translations.idiomatic: An Chonghui, privy commissioner and grand commandant, became inspector grand master and Hedong commissioner, advanced to duke of Yi.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以右威衛上將軍陳皋為洋州節度使。

translations.literal: On jiyou Right Majestic Guard senior general Chen Gao was made Yang prefecture military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Chen Gao of the right majestic guard became Yang commissioner.

sentences.zh: 詔諸府少尹上任，以二十五日為限。

translations.literal: An edict: subordinate prefects of all prefectures taking office—twenty-five days as the limit.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate prefects were given twenty-five days to take office.

sentences.zh: 諸州刺史、諸道行軍司馬、副使、兩使判官已下賓職，團防軍事判官、推官、府縣官等，並以三十日為限。

translations.literal: All prefecture governors, circuit campaign marshals, vice commissioners, two-bureau clerks and below as guest posts, regimental military clerks, sheriffs, prefectural and county officials, etc.—all thirty days as the limit.
translations.idiomatic: Governors, circuit staff, clerks, and county officials had thirty days.

sentences.zh: 幕職隨府者不在此例。

translations.literal: Staff following their prefecture were excluded from this rule.
translations.idiomatic: Staff attached to a prefecture were exempt.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，邠州節度使李敬周移鎮徐州。

translations.literal: On guichou Bin prefecture military commissioner Li Jingzhou was transferred to garrison Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Li Jingzhou of Bin moved to Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 詔禁天下開發無主墳墓。

translations.literal: An edict forbade opening ownerless tombs throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Opening unmarked graves was forbidden empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，詔渤海國人皇王突欲宜賜姓東丹，名慕華，仍授檢校太保、安東都護，充懷化軍節度、瑞鎮等州觀察等使。

translations.literal: Third month xinyou: an edict—the Bohai state person, Royal Eastern Dan king Tuyu should be granted the surname Eastern Dan, name Muhua, and also made Inspector Grand Guardian, Andong protector-general, Huaihua Army military commissioner and Ruizhen circuit inspector, etc.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on xinyou Tuyu of Bohai was given the surname Eastern Dan and name Muhua, made inspector grand guardian, Andong protector, and Huaihua commissioner with Ruizhen inspection duties.

sentences.zh: 其從慕華歸國部校，各授懷化、歸德將軍中郎將。

translations.literal: His followers returning with Muhua to their state—department officers each granted Huaihua and Guide generals and middle-rank commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Officers accompanying Muhua home received Huaihua and Guide general ranks.

sentences.zh: 先於定州擒獲蕃將，惕隱宜賜姓狄，名懷惠，則骨宜賜姓列，名知恩，並授檢校右散騎常侍。

translations.literal: Khitan officers captured earlier at Ding prefecture—Tiyin should be granted surname Di, name Huaihui; Zegu surname Lie, name Zhien—both made Inspector Right Regular Attendant of the Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan captives from Dingzhou—Tiyin became Di Huaihui and Zegu Lie Zhien, both inspector right cavalry attendant.

sentences.zh: 舍利則剌宜賜姓原，名知感；

translations.literal: Sheli Zelaji should be granted surname Yuan, name Zhigan;
translations.idiomatic: Sheli Zelaji took the surname Yuan and name Zhigan;

sentences.zh: 棫骨宜賜姓服，名懷造；

translations.literal: Yugui should be granted surname Fu, name Huaizao;
translations.idiomatic: Yugui took Fu and Huaizao;

sentences.zh: 奚王副使竭失訖宜賜姓乙，名懷宥，三人並授檢校太子賓客。

translations.literal: Xi king deputy envoy Jieshiqi should be granted surname Yi, name Huaiyou—the three all made Inspector Heir Apparent Guests.
translations.idiomatic: Jieshiqi of the Xi took Yi Huaiyou; all three became inspector heir-apparent guests.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以前鴻臚卿王瓊為太僕卿。

translations.literal: On jiazi former Master of Guests Wang Qiong was made Master of Transport.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi former master of guests Wang Qiong became master of transport.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以皇子從珂為左衛大將軍。

translations.literal: On bingyin the Prince Congke was made Left Guard senior general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Prince Li Congke became left guard senior general.

sentences.zh: 從珂自河中失守，歸清化裏第，至是安重誨出鎮河中，帝召見，泣而謂之曰：「如重誨意，爾安得更相見耶！

translations.literal: Congke since losing Hedong had returned to his residence in Qinghua Lane; now An Chonghui went out to garrison Hedong—the Emperor summoned him, weeping said: "As Chonghui wished, how could you meet again!
translations.idiomatic: Congke had lost Hedong and lived in Qinghua Lane; when An Chonghui left for Hedong Mingzong summoned him weeping: "As Chonghui wished, you would never meet again!

sentences.zh: 」因有是命。

translations.literal: 」Hence this appointment.
translations.idiomatic: 」Hence this post.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以滄州節度使孔循卒廢朝。

translations.literal: On renshen Cangzhou military commissioner Kong Xun died—court suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Kong Xun of Cangzhou died and court was suspended.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以西京留守、權知興元軍府事王思同為山南西道節度使，充西面行營馬步軍都虞候。

translations.literal: On yihai Western Capital regent and acting Xingyuan military prefect Wang Sitong was made Shannan West Circuit military commissioner and western campaign horse-and-foot army chief adjutant.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Wang Sitong, western capital regent, became Shannan West commissioner and western campaign chief adjutant.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以少府監聶延祚為殿中監，以前雲州節度使楊漢章為安州節度使。

translations.literal: On gengchen Court Artisan Supervisor Nie Yanzuo was made Palace Supervisor; former Yunzhou military commissioner Yang Hanzhang was made Anzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Nie Yanzuo became palace supervisor and Yang Hanzhang of Yunzhou became An commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，太師致仕錢鏐復授天下兵馬都元帥、尚父、吳越國王，以其子兩浙節度使元瓘等上表首罪，故有是命。

translations.literal: On yiyou retired Grand Master Qian Liu was again invested Supreme Commander of All Armies, August Father, King of Wu-Yue—because his son Liang-Zhe military commissioner Yuanjuan and others memorialized accepting guilt, hence this order.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou retired grand master Qian Liu was restored as supreme commander, august father, and king of Wu-Yue after his son Yuanjuan confessed fault in memorial.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以太常卿李愚為中書侍郎、平章事、集賢殿大學士。

translations.literal: On dinghai Minister of Ceremonies Li Yu was made Secretariat Vice Director, Grand Councillor, and Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Li Yu of ceremonies became secretariat vice director, grand councillor, and hall of assembled worthies academician.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯，製德妃王氏進位淑妃。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month xinmao: Imperial Consort Virtue Wang was advanced to Lady of Graceful Character.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Wang, imperial consort of virtue, was advanced to graceful consort.

sentences.zh: 詔錢鏐依舊賜不名。

translations.literal: An edict: Qian Liu as before granted the honor of not being named in memorials.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Liu was again exempted from having his name written in memorials.

sentences.zh: 誅內官安希倫，以其受安重誨密指，令於內中伺帝起居故也。

translations.literal: The inner eunuch An Xilun was executed—for receiving An Chonghui's secret orders to spy on the Emperor's movements within the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuch An Xilun was executed for spying on Mingzong at An Chonghui's orders.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，幸會節園，宴群臣，因幸河南府。

translations.literal: On dingyou the Emperor visited the Festival Garden, feasted the hundred officials, and then visited Henan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Mingzong feasted officials at the Festival Garden and then visited Henan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 詔罷州縣官到任後率斂為地圖；

translations.literal: An edict abolished prefectural and county officials on taking office levying funds for maps;
translations.idiomatic: Officials were forbidden to levy map fees on taking office;

sentences.zh: 又禁人毀廢所在碑碣，恐名賢遺行失所考也。

translations.literal: also forbade people destroying local steles and tablets, fearing famous worthies' surviving conduct would lose verification.
translations.idiomatic: and destroying local monuments was banned lest records of worthies be lost.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔今年四月禘饗太廟。

translations.literal: On wuxu an edict: this year's fourth month di offering at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu an edict ordered the di offering at the Grand Temple in the fourth month.

sentences.zh: 故昭義節度使李嗣昭、故幽州節度使周德威、故汴州節度使符存審，並配饗莊宗廟廷。

translations.literal: The late Zhaoyi military commissioner Li Sizhao, late Youzhou military commissioner Zhou Dewei, late Bianzhou military commissioner Fu Cunshen—all were collaterally offered in Zhuangzong's temple hall.
translations.idiomatic: Li Sizhao, Zhou Dewei, and Fu Cunshen were given collateral offerings in Zhuangzong's temple.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以前徐州節度使張虔釗為鳳翔節度使。

translations.literal: On jihai former Xuzhou military commissioner Zhang Qianzhao was made Fengxiang military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Zhang Qianzhao of Xuzhou became Fengxiang commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以汴州節度副使藥縱之為戶部侍郎，前宗正卿李諧為將作監。

translations.literal: On guimao Bianzhou vice commissioner Yao Zongzhi was made Vice Minister of Revenue; former Director of the Imperial Clan Li Xie was made Director of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Yao Zongzhi of Bianzhou became vice revenue minister and Li Xie former clan director became director of works.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以宣徽北院使、左衛上將軍趙延壽為檢校太傅、行禮部尚書，充樞密使。

translations.literal: On jiachen Northern Palace Bureau commissioner and Left Guard senior general Zhao Yanshou was made Inspector Grand Tutor, acting Minister of Rites, and Privy Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Zhao Yanshou became inspector grand tutor, acting rites minister, and privy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，潞州節度使劉仲殷移鎮秦州。

translations.literal: On yisi Lu prefecture military commissioner Liu Zhongyin was transferred to garrison Qin prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Liu Zhongyin of Lu moved to Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 帝幸龍門佛寺祈雨。

translations.literal: The Emperor visited Longmen Buddhist temple to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong prayed for rain at Longmen temple.

sentences.zh: 己酉，天雄軍節度使石敬瑭兼六軍諸衛副使。

translations.literal: On jiyou Tianxiong Army military commissioner Shi Jingtang was made concurrent deputy of the Six Armies and guards.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Shi Jingtang of Tianxiong became deputy of the six armies and guards.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以前鳳翔節度使朱宏昭為左武衛上將軍，充宣徽南院使。

translations.literal: On xinhai former Fengxiang military commissioner Zhu Hongzhao was made Left Martial Guard senior general and Southern Palace Bureau commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Zhu Hongzhao of Fengxiang became left martial guard senior general and southern palace bureau commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以兵部尚書盧質為河陽節度使。

translations.literal: On renzi Minister of War Lu Zhi was made Heyang military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Lu Zhi of war became Heyang commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以遂州節度使夏魯奇沒於王事廢朝。

translations.literal: On jiayin Suizhou military commissioner Xia Luqi died in royal service—court suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Xia Luqi of Suizhou died on duty and court was suspended.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「久摐時雨，深疚予心。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Long without timely rain—deeply guilty is our heart.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Prolonged drought weighs on our heart.

sentences.zh: 宜委諸州府長吏親問刑獄，省察冤濫，見禁囚徒，除死罪外，並放。」

translations.literal: It is fitting to entrust prefectural and circuit chief officials to personally examine criminal cases, review wrongful and excessive imprisonment; all prisoners in custody—excepting death crimes—all released."
translations.idiomatic: Let prefectural chiefs review trials, correct wrongful detention, and release all prisoners except those condemned to death."

sentences.zh: 五月戊午朔，帝御文明殿受朝。

translations.literal: Fifth month, wuwu new moon: the Emperor took the Civilized Illumination Hall to receive court.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu new moon of the fifth month Mingzong held court at the Civilized Illumination Hall.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以三司使、行工部尚書張延朗為兗州節度使。

translations.literal: On gengshen Commissioner of the Three Departments, acting Minister of Works Zhang Yanlang was made Yanzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Zhang Yanlang, three departments commissioner, became Yanzhou commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔：「近聞百執事等，或親居內職，或貴列廷臣，或宣達君恩，或勾當公事，經由列鎮，幹撓諸侯，指射職員，安排親昵，或潛示意旨，或顯發書題。

translations.literal: On xinyou an edict: "Recently heard that the hundred executors, etc., some holding inner posts personally, some noble ministers of court, some conveying sovereign grace, some managing public affairs—passing through successive garrisons, interfering with regional lords, aiming at staff, arranging intimates, some secretly indicating intent, some openly sending documents.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou an edict forbade court agents traveling circuits from meddling with regional lords, placing favorites, or secretly or openly directing staff.

sentences.zh: 自今後一切止絕，有所犯者，發薦人貶官，求薦人流配。

translations.literal: From now all is completely stopped; violators—the recommender is demoted, the job-seeker is exiled.
translations.idiomatic: Violators would demote the recommender and exile the seeker.

sentences.zh: 如逐處長吏自徇人情，隻仰被替人詣闕上訴，長吏罰兩月俸，發薦人更加一等，被替人卻令依舊。

translations.literal: If local chiefs indulge personal favor, only the replaced person may appeal at court; the chief is fined two months' salary, the recommender punished one grade higher, and the replaced person is ordered back as before.
translations.idiomatic: If a local chief showed favoritism only the displaced official could appeal; the chief lost two months' pay, the recommender was punished more severely, and the displaced man kept his post.

sentences.zh: 」甲子，都官郎中、知制誥崔棁上言，請搜訪宣宗已來野史，以備編修，從之。

translations.literal: 」On jiazi Director of Punishments, drafter of edicts Cui Zhuang memorialized asking to search for unofficial histories since Emperor Xuanzong for compilation—approved.
translations.idiomatic: 」On jiazi Cui Zhuang asked to gather unofficial histories since Xuanzong for compilation, and it was approved.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔：「諸州府城郭內依舊禁曲，其曲官中自造，減舊價之半貨賣。

translations.literal: On dingmao an edict: "In walled cities of all prefectures wine remains banned as before; officials shall brew it themselves, sell at half the old price.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao cities kept the wine monopoly but official brew sold at half price.

sentences.zh: 應田畝上所征曲錢並放，鄉村人戶一任私造。

translations.literal: Wine tax on field acres is all remitted; village households may brew privately as they wish.
translations.idiomatic: Field wine taxes were remitted and villagers could brew freely.

sentences.zh: 」時甚便之。

translations.literal: 」At the time it greatly benefited people.
translations.idiomatic: 」The change greatly helped the people.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，中書奏，應朝臣丁憂者，望加頒賚，從之。

translations.literal: On wuchen the Secretariat memorialized: for court officials in mourning, it is hoped funeral gifts be increased—approved.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the secretariat's request to increase mourning gifts for officials was approved.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以秘書監劉嶽為太常卿。

translations.literal: On dingchou Director of the Secretariat Archives Liu Yue was made Minister of Ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Liu Yue became minister of ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以武德使孟漢瓊為右衛大將軍、知內侍省，充宣徽北院使。

translations.literal: On jimao Martial Virtue commissioner Meng Hanqiong was made Right Guard senior general, acting Director of Palace Attendants, Northern Palace Bureau commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Meng Hanqiong became right guard senior general, acting palace attendant director, and northern palace bureau commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以前相州刺史孟鵠為左驍衛大將軍，充三司使。

translations.literal: On xinsi former Xiangzhou inspector Meng Hu was made Left Valiant Guard senior general and Commissioner of the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi former Xiangzhou inspector Meng Hu became left valiant guard senior general and three departments commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以權知朗州軍州事、守永州刺史馬希範為洪州節度使、檢校太傅；

translations.literal: On jiashen acting Langzhou military prefect, Yongzhou inspector Ma Xifan was made Hongzhou military commissioner and Inspector Grand Tutor;
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Ma Xifan, acting Lang prefect, became Hong commissioner and inspector grand tutor;

sentences.zh: 以權知桂州軍府事、富州刺史馬希彝為鄂州節度使、檢校司徒。

translations.literal: acting Guizhou military prefect, Fuzhou inspector Ma Xiyi was made Ezhou military commissioner and Inspector Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xiyi, acting Gui prefect, became E commissioner and inspector grand mentor.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以左金吾大將軍薄文為晉州留後。

translations.literal: On yiyou Left Golden Crow senior general Bo Wen was made Jin prefecture acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Bo Wen became Jinzhou acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 鴻臚卿柳膺將齋郎文書賣與同姓人柳居則，伏罪，大理寺斷當大辟，緣經赦減死，追奪見任官，終身不齒。

translations.literal: Master of Guests Liu Ying intended to sell a ritual scholar's documents to his clansman Liu Juzhe, confessed guilt; the Court of Judicial Review sentenced capital punishment; because of a recent amnesty death was reduced—current office stripped, never ranked for life.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Ying of guests tried to sell a ritual scholar's credentials to Liu Juzhe; though capital sentence was reduced by amnesty he lost office and rank for life.

sentences.zh: 詔：「應見任前資守選官等，所有本朝及梁朝出身曆任告身，並仰送納，委所在磨勘，換給公憑，隻以中興已來官告，及近受文書敘理。

translations.literal: An edict: "All incumbents, former qualified men awaiting selection, etc.—all conferral documents of origin in this dynasty and Liang, and service records, are to be sent in, entrusted to local verification, exchanged for public credentials—only post-restoration appointments and recent documents to be entered.
translations.idiomatic: Officials had to surrender Tang and Liang appointment records for verification and new credentials based only on post-restoration appointments.

sentences.zh: 其諸色蔭補子孫，如非虛假，不計庶嫡，並宜敘錄；

translations.literal: All categories of yin-privilege heirs—if not false, regardless of secondary or legitimate issue—all should be recorded;
translations.idiomatic: Legitimate yin heirs, if genuine, were to be recorded regardless of birth status;

sentences.zh: 如實無子孫，別立人繼嗣，已補得身名者，隻許敘蔭一人。

translations.literal: if truly without descendants, another person may be established as heir; those already enrolled—only one yin privilege to be entered.
translations.idiomatic: where there were no heirs only one adopted successor with existing enrollment could claim yin;

sentences.zh: 其不合敘使文書，限百日內焚毀須絕。

translations.literal: Documents not fit for enrollment—within one hundred days burn completely.
translations.idiomatic: invalid documents had to be destroyed within a hundred days.

sentences.zh: 此後更敢將合焚文書參選求仕，其所犯之人並傳者，並當極法。

translations.literal: Hereafter if anyone dares use documents that should have been burned to seek office, the violator and transmitter alike—all capital punishment.
translations.idiomatic: using burned documents for office afterward brought capital punishment on holder and transmitter.

sentences.zh: 應合得資蔭出身人，並須依格依令施行。」

translations.literal: All who should receive capital-yin origin must follow regulations and statutes."
translations.idiomatic: All yin candidates had to follow regulations and statutes."

sentences.zh: 閏月庚寅，製河中節度使、檢校太師、兼中書令安重誨可太子太師致仕。

translations.literal: Intercalary month gengyin: Hedong military commissioner, Inspector Grand Master, concurrent Secretariat Director An Chonghui may retire as Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin of the intercalary month An Chonghui was allowed to retire as grand tutor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 是日，重誨男崇緒等潛歸河中。

translations.literal: That day Chonghui's son Chongxu and others secretly returned to Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: That day Chonghui's sons Chongxu and others secretly fled to Hedong.

sentences.zh: 以右散騎常侍張文寶為兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: Right Regular Attendant of the Cavalry Zhang Wenbao was made Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Wenbao became vice war minister.

sentences.zh: 夔州節度使安崇阮棄城歸闕，待罪於閣門，詔釋之。

translations.literal: Kuizhou military commissioner An Chongruan abandoned his city and returned to court, awaited punishment at the Gate Department—the edict released him.
translations.idiomatic: An Chongruan of Kuizhou abandoned his post and surrendered at the gate; he was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 時董璋寇峽內諸州，崇阮望風遁走。

translations.literal: At the time Dong Zhang raided the gorges' inner prefectures; Chongruan fled at sight of the wind.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Zhang was raiding the gorges and Chongruan had fled before him.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，陝州節度使李從璋移鎮河中。

translations.literal: On renchen Shanzhou military commissioner Li Congzhang was transferred to garrison Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Li Congzhang of Shan moved to Hedong.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，升廬州為昭順軍。

translations.literal: On guichou Luzhou was promoted to Zhaoshun Army.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Luzhou became the Zhaoshun Army.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以衡州刺史姚彥章為昭順軍節度使。

translations.literal: On jiawu Hengzhou inspector Yao Yanzhang was made Zhaoshun Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Yao Yanzhang of Heng became Zhaoshun commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，安重誨奏：「男崇讚、崇緒等到州，臣已拘送赴闕。

translations.literal: On dingyou An Chonghui memorialized: "Sons Chongzan, Chongxu, etc. reached the prefecture—I have detained and sent them to court.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou An Chonghui reported his sons Chongzan and Chongxu detained and sent to court.

sentences.zh: 」崇緒至陝州，詔令下獄。

translations.literal: 」Chongxu reached Shanzhou—the edict ordered imprisonment.
translations.idiomatic: 」When Chongxu reached Shan he was jailed by edict.

sentences.zh: 已亥，詔安重誨宜削奪在身官爵，並妻阿張、男崇讚崇緒等並賜死，其餘親不問。

translations.literal: On jihai an edict: An Chonghui should be stripped of all ranks held and his wife A Zhang and sons Chongzan, Chongxu, etc. all granted death—the rest of kin not prosecuted.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai An Chonghui was stripped of rank and his wife A Zhang and sons Chongzan and Chongxu were sentenced to death; other kin were spared.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以尚書左丞崔居儉為工部尚書，以吏部侍郎王權為尚書左丞。

translations.literal: On renyin Left Secretariat Director Cui Jujian was made Minister of Works; Vice Minister of Personnel Wang Quan was made Left Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Cui Jujian became works minister and Wang Quan personnel vice minister became left secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以隨駕馬軍都指揮使、宣州節度使安從進為陝州節度使。

translations.literal: On bingwu imperial escort horse-army commander, Xuanzhou military commissioner An Congjin was made Shanzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu An Congjin, escort horse commander, became Shan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以前中書舍人楊凝式為左散騎常侍。

translations.literal: On dingwei former Secretariat Drafting Officer Yang Ningshi was made Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Yang Ningshi became left cavalry attendant.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以右龍武統軍王景戡為新州節度使。

translations.literal: On wushen Right Dragon Martial commanding general Wang Jingkan was made Xinzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Wang Jingkan became Xin commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以右領軍上將軍李肅為左金吾大將軍。

translations.literal: On jiyou Right Leading Army senior general Li Su was made Left Golden Crow senior general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Li Su became left golden crow senior general.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以隨駕步軍都指揮使藥彥稠為邠州節度使。

translations.literal: On renzi imperial escort foot-army commander Yao Yanchou was made Binzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Yao Yanchou became Bin commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以邠州節度使劉行琮卒廢朝，贈太傅。

translations.literal: On guichou Binzhou military commissioner Liu Xingcong died—court suspended; posthumously made Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Liu Xingcong of Bin died; court was suspended and he was posthumously grand tutor.

sentences.zh: 詔有司及天下州縣，於律令、格式、《六典》中錄本局公事，書於廳壁，令其遵行。

translations.literal: An edict: responsible offices and all prefectures and counties—from statutes, precedents, and the 《Six Offices Canon》 record their bureau's public affairs, write on hall walls, order them to follow.
translations.idiomatic: Offices were to post their duties from statutes and the 《Six Offices Canon》 on hall walls for compliance.

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳朔，復置明法科，同《開元禮》。

translations.literal: Sixth month, dingsi new moon: the Clear Law examination was restored, together with the 《Kaiyuan Rites》.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi new moon of the sixth month the law examination was restored along with the 《Kaiyuan Rites》.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以皇子左衛大將軍從珂依前檢校太傅，加同平章事、行京兆尹，充西都留守。

translations.literal: On yichou the Prince, Left Guard senior general Congke, as before Inspector Grand Tutor, was made concurrent Grand Councillor, acting Jingzhao intendant, Western Capital regent.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Li Congke became again inspector grand tutor, grand councillor, acting Jingzhao intendant, and western capital regent.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以邠州節度使張溫為右龍武統軍。

translations.literal: On gengwu Binzhou military commissioner Zhang Wen was made Right Dragon Martial commanding general.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Zhang Wen of Bin became right dragon martial commander.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以魏征八代孫韶為安定縣主簿。

translations.literal: On jiaxu the eighth-generation descendant of Wei Zheng, Shao, was made Anning county chief clerk.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Shao, eighth-generation descendant of Wei Zheng, became Anning county chief clerk.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以鎮州節度使、宋王從厚為興唐尹，以石敬瑭為河陽天雄軍節度使，以天雄軍節度使石敬班為河陽節度使，依前六軍諸衛副使。

translations.literal: On yihai Zhenzhou military commissioner, Prince of Song Conghou was made Xingtang intendant; Shi Jingtang was made Heyang-Tianxiong military commissioner; Tianxiong military commissioner Shi Jingban was made Heyang military commissioner, continuing as before deputy of Six Armies and guards.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Conghou of Song became Xingtang intendant; Shi Jingtang took Heyang-Tianxiong; Shi Jingban took Heyang while keeping six armies deputy.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔諸道觀察使均補苗稅，將有力人戶出剩田畝，補貧下不迨頃畝，有嗣者排改檢括，自今年起為定額。

translations.literal: On bingzi an edict: circuit inspectors should evenly supplement seedling tax—take surplus field acres from strong households to supplement poor households short of full mou; where heirs exist, reorder and inspect—from this year as fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi circuit inspectors were to equalize seedling tax by reallocating surplus land from wealthy to poor households, with heirs re-surveyed, fixing quotas from this year.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，定州節度使李從敏移鎮州節度使，盧質為滄州節度使。

translations.literal: On yimao, Dingzhou military commissioner Li Congmin was transferred to Zhenzhou military commissioner; Lu Zhi was made Cangzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Li Congmin of Ding moved to Zhen and Lu Zhi became Cang commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，皇孫太子舍人重美授司勳員外郎，重真已下六人並授同正將軍及檢校官。

translations.literal: On gengchen, the imperial grandson and crown prince aide Chongmei was made Vice Director of the Ministry of Merit; Chongzhen and six others below were all made honorary regular generals and acting commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen imperial grandson Chongmei, crown prince aide, became vice director of merit; Chongzhen and six below received honorary regular general and acting commissioner posts.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以前秦州節度使李德充為定州節度使兼北面行營副招討使。

translations.literal: On renwu, former Qinzhou military commissioner Li Dechong was made Dingzhou military commissioner and deputy northern campaign suppression commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu former Qin commissioner Li Dechong became Ding commissioner and deputy northern campaign suppression commissioner.

sentences.zh: 太原地震。

translations.literal: Taiyuan had an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Taiyuan shook.

sentences.zh: 詔天下州府斷獄，先於案牘之上坐所該律令、格式及新敕，然後區分。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that in trials throughout the realm, the applicable statutes, regulations, and new decrees must be set atop the dossier first, then judgment rendered.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong ordered that in trials everywhere the governing statutes, regulations, and new decrees be placed atop the dossier before judgment.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以前黔州節度使楊漢賓為羽林統軍。

translations.literal: On yiyou, former Qianzhou military commissioner Yang Hanbin was made commander of the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou former Qian commissioner Yang Hanbin became commander of the Feathered Forest.

sentences.zh: 詔止絕諸射係省店宅莊園。

translations.literal: An edict halted all seized provincial bureau shops, residences, and estates.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ended seizures of provincial bureau shops, residences, and estates.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚寅，以權侍衛馬軍都指揮使、登州刺史張從實為壽州節度使兼侍衛步軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: Seventh month, autumn, gengyin: Acting commander of the palace horse guard and Dengzhou prefect Zhang Congshi was made Shouzhou military commissioner and commander of the palace foot guard.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin in the seventh month acting palace horse guard commander Zhang Congshi of Deng became Shou commissioner and palace foot guard commander.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，福建王延鈞上言：「當境廟七所，乞封王號。

translations.literal: On renchen, Fujian's Wang Yanjun memorialized: "Seven shrines in my circuit beg enfeoffment with kingly titles.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Wang Yanjun of Fujian asked that seven shrines in his circuit receive kingly titles.

sentences.zh: 」敕：「如諸史傳有名，宜封為閩越富義王，其餘任自於境內祭享。

translations.literal: 」An edict: "Those named in historical texts should be enfeoffed as King of Min-Yue Fuyi; the rest may be worshipped within the circuit at will.
translations.idiomatic: 」The court replied: figures named in historical texts should be titled King of Min-Yue Fuyi; the rest might be worshipped locally.

sentences.zh: 」乙未，詔：「諸道奏薦州縣官，使相先許一年薦三人，今許薦五人；

translations.literal: 」On yimao, an edict: "For circuit recommendations of prefectural and county officers, military commissioners formerly allowed three per year—now five;
translations.idiomatic: 」On yimao Mingzong raised circuit recommendations: commissioners from three to five per year;

sentences.zh: 不帶使相先許薦二人，今許薦三人；

translations.literal: those without commissioner rank formerly two—now three;
translations.idiomatic: those without commissioner rank from two to three;

sentences.zh: 直屬京防禦、團練使先許薦一人，今許薦二人。

translations.literal: direct capital defense and training commissioners formerly one—now two.
translations.idiomatic: direct capital defense and training commissioners from one to two.

sentences.zh: 」詔：「應州縣官內，有曾在朝行及曾佐幕府，罷任後，準前資朝官賓從別處分。

translations.literal: 」An edict: "Among prefectural and county officers, those who had served at court or on staffs, after leaving office shall be treated like court rank retainers.
translations.idiomatic: 」Another edict: former court or staff service entitled county officers to retainer treatment after leaving office.

sentences.zh: 其帶省銜，並內供奉裏行及諸已出選門者，或降授令錄，罷任日，並依出選門例處分，便與除官，更不在赴常調。

translations.literal: Those bearing provincial titles, inner court attendants in probation, and all who had passed selection—if demoted to magistrate or recorder, on leaving office shall be appointed by selection rules without regular rotation.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial-title holders, probationary inner attendants, and selection graduates demoted to magistrate or recorder were to be appointed on leaving without regular rotation.

sentences.zh: 州縣官其間書得十六考者，準格敘加朝散階，亦準出選門例處分。

translations.literal: County officers with sixteen evaluations receive Court Scattered rank per statute, also by selection rules.
translations.idiomatic: County officers with sixteen evaluations gained Court Scattered rank and selection-rule treatment.

sentences.zh: 」三司奏：「先許百姓造曲，不來官場收買。

translations.literal: 」The Revenue Commission memorialized: "Previously allowing private brewing, none sold to government yards—
translations.idiomatic: 」The Revenue Commission said private brewing had not reached government yards—

sentences.zh: 伏恐課額不逮，請復已前曲法，鄉戶與在城條法一例指揮，仍據已造到曲納官，量支還麥本。

translations.literal: we fear revenue shortfall; we ask restoring prior liquor law, rural and urban under one rule, turning in brewed liquor to the state for grain refund.
translations.idiomatic: fearing shortfall they asked to restore the old liquor monopoly, unify rural and urban rules, and surrender brewed liquor for grain refunds.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: 」It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: 」Approved.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，前晉州節度使朱漢賓授太子少保致仕。

translations.literal: On jiachen, former Jinzhou military commissioner Zhu Hanbin was granted retired Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen former Jin commissioner Zhu Hanbin retired as grand guardian of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，大理正劇可久責授登州司戶，刑部員外郎裴選責授衛尉寺丞，刑部侍郎李光序、判大理卿事任讚各降一官，罰一季俸，坐斷罪失入也。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Da li corrector Ju Keyong was demoted to Dengzhou registrar; Ministry of Punishments vice director Pei Xuan to Weiwei assistant; vice minister Li Guangxu and acting Da li chief Ren Zan each demoted one rank and fined one quarter's salary for erroneous sentencing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Ju Keyong of Da li was demoted to Deng registrar; Pei Xuan of punishments to Weiwei aide; Li Guangxu and acting Da li chief Ren Zan each lost a rank and a quarter's pay for sentencing errors.

sentences.zh: 八月丙寅，詔天下州府商稅務，並委逐處差人依省司年額勾當納官。

translations.literal: Eighth month, bingyin: an edict ordered commercial tax bureaus throughout the realm to appoint local agents to meet annual provincial quotas and remit to the state.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin in the eighth month commercial tax offices nationwide were told to appoint local agents to meet annual quotas.

sentences.zh: 以故鎮州節度使、趙王王熔男昭誨為朝議大夫、司農少卿，賜紫金魚袋，繼絕也。

translations.literal: Deceased Zhenzhou military commissioner and Prince of Zhao Wang Rong's son Zhaohui was made Court Discussant and Vice Director of Agriculture, given purple-gold fish bag—as heir to an extinct line.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Rong's son Zhaohui, heir to the extinct Prince of Zhao line, became court discussant and vice director of agriculture with a purple-gold fish bag.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，升虔州為昭信軍。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Qianzhou was elevated to Zhaoxin circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Qianzhou became Zhaoxin circuit.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以太常少卿盧文紀為秘書監，以秘書監馬縞為太子賓客，左監門上將軍羅周敬為右領軍上將軍，前懷州刺史婁繼英為左監門上將軍。

translations.literal: On guihai, Deputy Director of Rites Lu Wenji became Director of the Secretariat; Secretariat Director Ma Gao became Crown Prince Guest; Left Gate General Luo Zhoujing became Right Collar General; former Huai prefect Lou Jiying became Left Gate General.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Lu Wenji of rites became secretariat director; Ma Gao of the secretariat became crown prince guest; Luo Zhoujing of the left gate became right collar general; former Huai prefect Lou Jiying became left gate general.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔：「大理寺官員，宜同台省官例升進，法直官比禮直官任使。

translations.literal: On yichou, an edict: "Da li officers shall advance like central ministry officials; legal clerks ranked like ritual clerks.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Mingzong ordered Da li officers to advance like central ministry officials and legal clerks to rank like ritual clerks.

sentences.zh: 仍於諸道贓罰錢內，每月支錢一百貫文，賜刑部、大理兩司，其刑部於所賜錢三分與一分。

translations.literal: From circuit fine revenues, one hundred strings monthly to Punishments and Da li; Punishments receives one-third.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred strings monthly from circuit fines were to go to punishments and Da li, punishments taking one-third.

sentences.zh: 」丙寅，以武平軍節度使馬希振依前檢校太尉、兼侍中，充虔州昭信軍節度使。

translations.literal: 」On bingyin, Wuping military commissioner Ma Xizhen retained acting Grand Marshal and Palace Attendant and became Qianzhou Zhaoxin military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: 」On bingyin Ma Xizhen of Wuping kept grand marshal and palace attendant and became Qian-Zhaoxin commissioner.

sentences.zh: 詔：「百官職吏，應選授外官者，考滿日，並委本州申奏，追還本司，依舊職行公事。

translations.literal: An edict: "Clerks selected for outside posts, when evaluation ends, the prefecture shall memorialize and recall them to original bureaus to resume duties.
translations.idiomatic: Clerks posted outside were to return to their bureaus when terms ended after prefectural memorial.

sentences.zh: 」己巳，太傅致仕王建立、太子少保致仕朱漢賓皆上章求歸鄉里。

translations.literal: 」On jisi, retired Grand Tutor Wang Jianli and retired Grand Guardian Zhu Hanbin both sought return home.
translations.idiomatic: 」On jisi retired grand tutor Wang Jianli and retired grand guardian Zhu Hanbin both asked to go home.

sentences.zh: 詔內外致仕官，凡要出入，不在拘束之限。

translations.literal: An edict: retired officials inward and outward were not bound when traveling on necessary business.
translations.idiomatic: Retired officials at court and in the provinces were freed from travel restrictions.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以翰林學士、兵部侍郎劉煦守本官，充端明殿學士；

translations.literal: On xinwei, Hanlin academician and War Vice Minister Liu Xu kept his posts and became Hall of Bright Comprehension academician;
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Liu Xu, Hanlin scholar and war vice minister, kept rank and became a Hall of Bright Comprehension academician;

sentences.zh: 以左拾遺、直樞密院李崧充樞密直學士。

translations.literal: Left Reminder and direct privy councilor Li Song became privy council academician.
translations.idiomatic: Left Reminder Li Song, direct privy councilor, became privy council academician.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以左龍武統軍李承約為潞州節度使。

translations.literal: On renshen, Left Majestic Dragon commander Li Chengyue became Luzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Li Chengyue of the left Majestic Dragon became Lu commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔：「文武百官，五日內殿起居仍舊，其輪次轉對宜停。

translations.literal: On guiyou, an edict: "Civil and military officials keep five-day inner court attendance; rotating audience speech is suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Mingzong kept five-day inner attendance but ended rotating audience speeches.

sentences.zh: 若有封事，許非時上表，朔望入閣，待制候對，一依舊制。

translations.literal: Memorials may be filed anytime; new and full moon palace entry and awaiting audience follow old rules.
translations.idiomatic: Sealed memorials could be filed anytime; new- and full-moon palace entry and awaiting audience followed old rules.

sentences.zh: 」乙亥，翰林學士、工部侍郎竇夢徵卒。

translations.literal: 」On yihai, Hanlin academician and Works Vice Minister Dou Mengzheng died.
translations.idiomatic: 」On yihai Hanlin scholar and works vice minister Dou Mengzheng died.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以前西京副留守梁文矩為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On dingchou, former western capital vice defender Liang Wenju became War Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou former western capital vice defender Liang Wenju became war minister.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔不得薦銀青階為州縣官。

translations.literal: On jimao, an edict forbade recommending silver-green rank for prefectural and county posts.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Mingzong forbade recommending silver-green rank for county posts.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔應有朝臣、藩侯、郡守，凡欲營葬，未曾封贈，許追封贈。

translations.literal: On renwu, an edict: courtiers, lords, and prefects planning burial without prior enfeoffment may receive posthumous honors.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu courtiers, lords, and prefects without prior honors might receive posthumous enfeoffment when burying kin.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書致仕李德休卒。

translations.literal: Retired Rites Minister Li Dexiu died.
translations.idiomatic: Retired rites minister Li Dexiu died.

sentences.zh: 九月丙戌，以前兗州節度使符彥超為左龍武統軍。

translations.literal: Ninth month, bingxu: former Yanzhou military commissioner Fu Yanchao became Left Majestic Dragon commander.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu in the ninth month former Yan commissioner Fu Yanchao became left Majestic Dragon commander.

sentences.zh: 己亥，懷化軍節度使東丹慕華賜姓名李讚華，改封隴西縣開國公。

translations.literal: On jihai, Huaihua military commissioner Eastern Dan Murong Hua was granted surname Li and name Zanhua, made Duke of Longxi county.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Murong Hua of Huaihua and Eastern Dan received the surname Li and name Zanhua and was made duke of Longxi county.

sentences.zh: 應有先配諸軍契丹並賜姓名。

translations.literal: All Khitan previously assigned to armies were granted surnames.
translations.idiomatic: All Khitan already assigned to armies received surnames.

sentences.zh: 詔天下營田務，隻許耕無主荒田及招浮客，不得留占屬縣編戶。

translations.literal: An edict: farm colonies may only till ownerless waste land and recruit floating clients, not retain registered households.
translations.idiomatic: Farm colonies might till only ownerless land and recruit floating clients, not hold registered households.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，樞密使、檢校太傅、刑部尚書範延光加同平章事，使如故。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Privy Councilor, acting Grand Tutor, and Punishments Minister Fan Yanguang added co-director; his post was unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou privy councilor Fan Yanguang, acting grand tutor and punishments minister, added co-director while keeping his post.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以中書舍人封翹為禮部侍郎，禮部侍郎盧澹為戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: On renyin, Secretariat Aide Feng Qiao became Rites Vice Minister; Rites Vice Minister Lu Tan became Revenue Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Feng Qiao of the secretariat became rites vice minister and Lu Tan of rites became revenue vice minister.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，許州節度使李從溫移鎮河東。

translations.literal: On guimao, Xuzhou military commissioner Li Congwen moved to Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Li Congwen of Xu moved to Hedong.

sentences.zh: 詔天下州縣官，不得與部內富民於公廳同坐。

translations.literal: An edict: prefectural and county officers must not sit with rich locals in the council hall.
translations.idiomatic: County officers were forbidden to sit with wealthy locals in the council hall.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔五坊見在鷹隼之類，並可就山林解放，今後不許進獻。

translations.literal: On xinhai, an edict: all hawks and falcons in the five workshops were released to the mountains; no more tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai hawks and falcons in the five workshops were released and future tribute was banned.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊午，以前北京留守、太原尹馮贇為許州節度使。

translations.literal: Tenth month, winter, wuwu: former northern capital defender and Taiyuan governor Feng Yun became Xuzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu in the tenth month former Beijing defender and Taiyuan governor Feng Yun became Xu commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，左補闕李詳上疏：「以北京地震多日，請遣使臣往彼慰撫，察問疾苦，祭祀山川。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Left Censor Li Xiang memorialized: "Beijing has shaken many days—send envoys to comfort, inquire into hardship, and sacrifice to mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Left Censor Li Xiang asked that prolonged Beijing earthquakes be met with envoys to comfort the people, inquire into hardship, and sacrifice to mountains and rivers.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: 」It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: 」Approved.

sentences.zh: 先是，太原留後密奏，無敢言者，及詳有是奏，帝甚嘉之，改賜章服。

translations.literal: Earlier Taiyuan's acting commissioner had reported secretly and none dared speak; the Emperor greatly praised Li Xiang and granted new robes.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Taiyuan's acting commissioner had reported secretly with none daring to speak; Mingzong praised Li Xiang and granted new robes.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔：「應在朝臣僚、藩侯、郡守，準例合得追贈者，新授命後，便於所司投狀，旋與施行。

translations.literal: On bingyin, an edict: "New appointees entitled to posthumous honors shall file immediately with the proper bureau for prompt action.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin new appointees entitled to posthumous honors were told to file at once with the proper bureau.

sentences.zh: 封妻蔭子，準格合得者，亦與施行。

translations.literal: Wives and sons per statute likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Wives and sons under statute likewise.

sentences.zh: 外官曾任朝班，據在朝品秩格例，合得封贈敘封者，並與施行。

translations.literal: Outside officers who had served at court receive honors by former rank.
translations.idiomatic: Outside officers who had sat at court received honors by former rank.

sentences.zh: 其補蔭，據資蔭合得者，先受官者先與收補，後受官者據月日次第施行。

translations.literal: For yin succession, prior appointments first, later ones by date.
translations.idiomatic: Yin appointments went to earlier recipients first, later ones by date.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: 」It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: 」Approved.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲申朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jiashen new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen new moon in the eleventh month the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 己丑，日南至，帝御文明殿受賀。

translations.literal: On jichou, the winter solstice; the Emperor received congratulations at Bright Culture Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, winter solstice, Mingzong received congratulations at Bright Culture Hall.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以翰林學士、起居郎張礰為兵部員外郎、知制誥充職；

translations.literal: On dingyou, Hanlin academician and Chief Recorder Zhang Ji became War Vice Director and drafter of edicts in that capacity;
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Zhang Ji, Hanlin scholar and chief recorder, became war vice director and edict drafter;

sentences.zh: 以汝州防禦使張希崇為靈州兩使留後。

translations.literal: Ruzhou defense commissioner Zhang Xichong became acting commissioner of both types at Lingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xichong of Ru became Ling's acting commissioner of both types.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以左威衛上將軍華溫琪為華州節度使。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Left Majestic Guard General Hua Wenqi became Huazhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Hua Wenqi of the left Majestic Guard became Hua commissioner.

sentences.zh: 福州節度使王延鈞奏，誅建州節度使王延稟及其子繼雄。

translations.literal: Fuzhou military commissioner Wang Yanjun reported executing Jianzhou military commissioner Wang Yanbing and his son Jixiong.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yanjun of Fuzhou reported executing Wang Yanbing of Jian and his son Jixiong.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔今後諸道兩使判官罷任一年與比擬，書記、支使、防禦團練判官二年，推巡、軍事判官並三年後與比擬。

translations.literal: On renyin, an edict: hereafter circuit deputy commissioners one year after term for comparison; recorders and aides two years; inspectors three.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin circuit deputies might be compared after one year, recorders and aides after two, inspectors after three.

sentences.zh: 仍每遇除授，量與改轉官資或階勳、職次雲。

translations.literal: Each appointment may adjust rank, insignia, or title as fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Each appointment might adjust rank, insignia, or title as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 以御史中丞劉讚為刑部侍郎，以鳳州節度使孫嶽充西面閣道使。

translations.literal: Censor-in-chief Liu Zan became Punishments Vice Minister; Fengzhou military commissioner Sun Yue became western pass commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zan, censor-in-chief, became punishments vice minister; Sun Yue of Feng became western pass commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬子，鄆州奏，黃河暴漲，漂溺四千餘戶。

translations.literal: On renzi, Yanzhou reported the Yellow River flooding and drowning more than four thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Yan reported the Yellow River had flooded and drowned more than four thousand households.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以給事中崔衍為御史中丞。

translations.literal: On guichou, Supervisor of Attendants Cui Yan became censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Cui Yan of the supervisors of attendants became censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲寅朔，詔開鐵禁，許百姓自鑄農器、什器之屬，於夏秋田畝上，每畝輸農器錢一錢五分。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jiayin new moon: an edict lifted the iron monopoly, allowing the people to cast farm tools and utensils; on summer-autumn fields, half a coin per mu in tool tax.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin new moon in the twelfth month the iron ban was lifted so people could cast farm tools; summer-autumn fields paid one and a half cash per mu.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，畋於西郊。

translations.literal: On yimao, the Emperor hunted in the western suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Mingzong hunted west of the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以彰武軍節度使劉訓卒廢朝。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Zhangwu military commissioner Liu Xun died; court mourning was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Liu Xun of Zhangwu died and court was suspended in mourning.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以前利州節度使康思立為陝州節度使。

translations.literal: On gengwu, former Lizhou military commissioner Kang Sili became Shanzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu former Li commissioner Kang Sili became Shan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 秦州地震。

translations.literal: Qinzhou had an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Qinzhou shook.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔三司，所過西川兵士家屬，常令贍給。

translations.literal: On dingchou, an edict to the Revenue Commission: families of soldiers passing through Xichuan shall be sustained.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the Revenue Commission was ordered to sustain families of soldiers passing through Xichuan.
